exposure: Urogenital Distress Inventory Short Form (UDI-6) scores
Incontinence Impact Questionnaire Short Form (IIQ-7) scores
cohort: The study included 303 women with new-onset stress urinary incontinence during pregnancy who underwent vaginal delivery in a university hospital between 2014 and 2015.
finding: At 12 months postpartum, 16.5% of women had persistent postpartum SUI, with advanced maternal age (>=35 years), gestational age at birth (>=40 weeks), and severe perineal lacerations identified as independent risk factors.
